A drug intended to partially offset the adverse effects of psi-radiation on humans. One of the few available ways to prevent the inside of your head from getting fried.

Enhances blood coagulation, accelerates wounbd healing, and reduces the likelihood of severe bleeding. Rumor has it that bloodsuckers tend to steer clear of those who regularly abuse this drug.
